sub_graphs.title: EIP-7805: Inclusion List Gossipsub Protocol
sub_graphs.description: Models the gossipsub message propagation and validation for inclusion lists on the P2P network

nodes.label: Gossip Message Received on inclusion_list Topic
nodes.description: A SignedInclusionList message has been received on the inclusion_list gossipsub topic

nodes.label: Check Transaction Size Bound
nodes.description: [REJECT] Verify that message.transactions size is within MAX_BYTES_PER_INCLUSION_LIST (8192 bytes)

nodes.label: Check Slot Validity
nodes.description: [REJECT] Verify that message.slot equals current slot or previous slot

nodes.label: Check Timing Constraints
nodes.description: [IGNORE] Verify timing relative to attestation due time for the slot

nodes.label: Verify Committee Root
nodes.description: [IGNORE] Verify inclusion_list_committee_root matches the actual committee for message.slot on current branch

nodes.label: Verify Committee Membership
nodes.description: [REJECT] Verify validator_index is a member of the inclusion list committee for the specified slot

nodes.label: Check Submission Limit
nodes.description: [IGNORE] Verify this is the first or second valid submission from this validator for this slot

nodes.label: Verify BLS Signature
nodes.description: [REJECT] Verify cryptographic BLS signature on the SignedInclusionList

nodes.label: Message Accepted and Forwarded
nodes.description: Message passed all validation checks, is accepted locally and forwarded to gossip peers

nodes.label: Message Rejected
nodes.description: Message failed a [REJECT] check; dropped and sender penalized

nodes.label: Message Ignored
nodes.description: Message failed an [IGNORE] check; dropped but sender not penalized

edges.label: All checks passed, accept and forward
Third or later submission from validator

external_entities.name: Gossipsub Peer
external_entities.description: Network peer sending SignedInclusionList messages on the inclusion_list gossip topic

sub_graphs.title: EIP-7805: Inclusion List Request/Response Protocol
sub_graphs.description: Models the req/resp protocol for requesting inclusion lists by committee indices

nodes.label: Req/Resp Request Received
nodes.description: A request for inclusion_list_by_committee_indices has been received specifying slot and committee_indices bitvector

nodes.label: Parse Request Parameters
nodes.description: Extract slot and committee_indices (Bitvector[INCLUSION_LIST_COMMITTEE_SIZE]) from the request

nodes.label: Lookup Stored Inclusion Lists
nodes.description: Search local storage for SignedInclusionList objects matching the requested slot and committee member indices

nodes.label: Build Response
nodes.description: Construct response as List[SignedInclusionList, MAX_REQUEST_INCLUSION_LIST (16)] with matching inclusion lists

nodes.label: Response Sent
nodes.description: Response containing requested inclusion lists has been sent to the requesting peer

external_entities.name: Requesting Peer
external_entities.description: Network peer requesting inclusion lists for specific committee members at a given slot

sub_graphs.title: EIP-7805: P2P Message Validation Security Boundaries
sub_graphs.description: Models the security boundaries at the P2P layer including REJECT vs IGNORE semantics and rate limiting

nodes.label: Untrusted Message from Network
nodes.description: Raw message from P2P network crosses trust boundary into local validation

nodes.label: Apply REJECT-Level Checks
nodes.description: Apply checks that result in peer scoring penalty on failure: tx size, slot validity, committee membership, signature

nodes.label: Apply IGNORE-Level Checks
nodes.description: Apply checks that silently drop without peer penalty: timing, committee root, submission rate limit

nodes.label: Enforce Per-Validator Submission Limit
nodes.description: Track and enforce that each validator submits at most 2 valid inclusion lists per slot

nodes.label: Peer Score Penalized
nodes.description: Sending peer's score is decreased due to REJECT-level validation failure

nodes.label: Message Silently Dropped
nodes.description: Message dropped without peer penalty due to IGNORE-level check failure

edges.label: Message enters validation at trust boundary
Exceeds 2 submissions per validator per slot

external_entities.name: Network Peer
external_entities.description: Any peer on the P2P network sending messages that cross the trust boundary into local validation

ambiguities.text: The spec allows 'first or second valid submission' from a validator but does not clarify under what circumstances a second submission is expected or valid.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the second submission allows for correction or updated transaction selection. Both submissions are treated as valid but only tracked for rate limiting.

ambiguities.text: The slot validity check accepts 'previous or current slot' but does not specify behavior at epoch boundaries or when the node's clock is slightly ahead/behind.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume standard slot clock tolerance applies. The previous slot allowance provides a one-slot grace period for propagation delay.

ambiguities.text: The req/resp protocol does not specify behavior when no inclusion lists are available for the requested slot/indices.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume an empty list is returned in the response, consistent with standard Ethereum req/resp patterns.

implicit_assumptions.description: Network propagation delay is assumed to be small enough that inclusion lists reach validators before attestation due time.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Late-arriving inclusion lists would be IGNORED due to timing constraints, reducing the effective committee size and censorship resistance.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker is assumed unable to flood the network with enough invalid inclusion lists to cause significant resource exhaustion, given the REJECT-level checks filter cheaply.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: A DoS attack with well-crafted messages that pass cheap checks but fail expensive checks (e.g., signature verification) could degrade node performance.

implicit_assumptions.description: The fork version hierarchy (EIP7805 → FULU → ELECTRA → ...) is assumed to be correctly configured in all clients for proper fork context determination.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Incorrect fork version could cause valid messages to be rejected or invalid messages to be accepted across fork boundaries.
